source_case_info.name: B16_P05_small_L5_Co050_heatStart30s
source_case_info.purpose: Small bead thermal production; not wake-resolved validation
source_case_info.initialization_caveat: Imported old small-bead U/p/turbulence with ambient T reset; startup transients remain
source_case_info.elapsed_time: OpenFOAM time in seconds; initial thermal field reset, developed flow retained

plane_sampling.note: Native mesh cut points, not a regular Cartesian grid

time_definition: time_s is original OpenFOAM time; elapsed_s subtracts case start (P03:30 s)
temperature_definition: Bead center/volume average, not an Experiment A T10 or heater temperature

heat_rate_signs.bead: Q_air_to_bead=-OF_Q_bead; negative raw means net bead heating
heat_rate_signs.radiation_direction: Names describe transfer across air-side interfaces, not absorption entirely by air or emission entirely from air
heat_rate_signs.raw: Original air-region wallHeatFlux integral, NOT renamed Fourier outward flux

electrical_input: Not exported: jacket temperature is prescribed, not electrical power input
history_policy: Restart tails clipped at next run start; linear interpolation only within each attempt; no extrapolation or interpolation across restart gaps. NaN denotes unavailable data. Initial uniform bead temperature is known; no initial heat rate is invented.
